text: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.
He said: I called out to the LORD from my distress, and he answered me; from the depths of the grave I cried for help, and you heard my voice.
You threw me into the deep, into the very heart of the seas, and the current swept around me; all your breakers and waves rolled over me.
I said, I have been driven from your sight — yet I will look again toward your holy temple.
The waters closed in over me, right up to my throat; the deep surrounded me, and seaweed wrapped around my head.
I sank to the very roots of the mountains; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.
As my life was slipping away, I remembered the LORD, and my prayer rose up to you, into your holy temple.
Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from the mercy that could be theirs.
But as for me, I will sacrifice to you with a voice of thanksgiving; I will pay what I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD!
Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it spit Jonah out onto dry land.
